section.title: Introduction and Overview
section.p: The Writable gadget was changed with Window 1.85.

subsection.title: Change in button type
subsection.p: Because of changes necessitated by other gadgets the writable gadget is now of type 'Write/Click/Drag' (button type 14). This means that mouse click events will appear for this Writable gadgets. For the most part this should not affect any correctly written application. Applications which are affected by this new behaviour should be modified to confirm that the gadget from which they are receiving a mouse click is in fact the gadget they believe it to be.
